# Optional Copilot review instructions

Use these instructions only after the owner explicitly authorizes a Copilot review for a specific pull request and revision. They do not authorize or trigger a review.

Pay particular attention to:

- accidental publication of research candidates or AI-generated political assessments;
- contradictions between confirmed decisions, working proposals, and open questions;
- loss of exact Czech quotations, sources, evidence provenance, or revision history;
- scoring logic that diverges from the canonical order in `docs/scoring.md`;
- collectors or matchers that silently assign political direction or score;
- public Czech text containing internal enum names or unexplained legal identifiers;
- changes that bypass exact-revision owner approval, validation, or production deployment boundaries.

Do not treat an automated assessment proposal or its review pull request as publication approval.
